## X-Sense Home Security v1.4.18.2

This pre-release continues the camera and SBS50 alarm-panel follow-up work from v1.4.18.1.

### 📷 Cameras
- Improves WebRTC ticket handling for accounts with multiple X-Sense Homes when X-Sense rejects the normal ADDX camera identity but accepts the APK camera device identity.
- Keeps the camera's ADDX Home/node context in place while retrying the ticket request, so camera access does not fall back to the wrong Home.

### 🔐 Alarm Panel
- Reworks SBS50 force-arm confirmation to use an authenticated Home Assistant action panel instead of a state-changing URL.
- Keeps the force-arm confirmation path separate from the recordings sidebar, so alarm systems without cameras can still use it.
- Shows the same force-arm confirmation flow for Home mode and Away mode when X-Sense reports open sensors.
